owner_creation.analysis: FILE:src/fault.rs: Five static atomics own the parsed site/ordinal/count/latch and borrowed trace FD number; initialization owns temporary OsStrings and stack libc metadata.
owner_creation.invariant: Hook state retains values rather than environment pointers.
limitations: Author review includes feature and test code; M0-SIG-002 is retained for caller context, without claiming the local hook itself allocates.

aliases_escapes.analysis: FILE:src/fault.rs: The sixteen-byte marker stays on the hit stack and is lent only during write_marker; the harness must keep its dedicated inherited pipe live until child exit.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Marker bytes cannot escape their synchronous write.
limitations: Author review includes feature and test code; M0-SIG-002 is retained for caller context, without claiming the local hook itself allocates.

callback_targets.analysis: FILE:src/fault.rs: Hook calls are direct libc operations plus local checked closures; no application callback is stored. Callers may still enter allocation from SIGUSR1 queue work (M0-SIG-002).
callback_targets.invariant: Hook-local callback safety cannot approve its caller.
limitations: Author review includes feature and test code; M0-SIG-002 is retained for caller context, without claiming the local hook itself allocates.

invalidation.analysis: FILE:src/fault.rs: initialize resets once before handlers; FD_CLOEXEC retires the child descriptor during exec and environment removal prevents inherited plan reuse.
invalidation.invariant: A live hook plan must retain its validated pipe identity.
limitations: Author review includes feature and test code; M0-SIG-002 is retained for caller context, without claiming the local hook itself allocates.

mutation_commit.analysis: FILE:src/fault.rs: Plan parsing and FD checks finish before FAIL_AT/TRACE_FD stores and Release publication of FAIL_SITE; hit uses Acquire before reading configuration.
mutation_commit.invariant: Enabling a site follows complete plan validation.
limitations: Author review includes feature and test code; M0-SIG-002 is retained for caller context, without claiming the local hook itself allocates.

release_pair.analysis: FILE:src/fault.rs: Temporary environment strings drop normally; atomics own no heap memory, and the inherited child pipe is retired by CLOEXEC or process exit rather than a hook close.
release_pair.invariant: Hook release does not close pager-owned descriptors.
limitations: Author review includes feature and test code; M0-SIG-002 is retained for caller context, without claiming the local hook itself allocates.

error_cleanup.analysis: FILE:src/fault.rs: Malformed plans fail before pager mutation; trace writes are bounded, nonblocking, preserve errno and reject absent/invalid marker evidence.
error_cleanup.invariant: Trace failure cannot fabricate a successful observation.
limitations: Author review includes feature and test code; M0-SIG-002 is retained for caller context, without claiming the local hook itself allocates.

signals_handoff.analysis: FILE:src/fault.rs: write_marker restores the prior mask and preserves existing SIGPIPE; lock-free hook mechanics do not repair asynchronous caller lookup/allocation.
signals_handoff.invariant: M0-SIG-002 remains an open caller-context hazard.
limitations: Author review includes feature and test code; M0-SIG-002 is retained for caller context, without claiming the local hook itself allocates.
